why: two findings from cold panel round 1, answered with measurements rather than argument

transductive_vs_inductive.question: does ranking a validation fold against ITSELF, rather than against the training fold's own score distribution, change the combined arm?
transductive_vs_inductive.note: no outcome enters either transform. A within-fold monotone map cannot change a SINGLE arm's concordance at all; only the combination can move, because the rank average depends on the relative scaling of the three arms.

stage_vs_grade_inference.note: the two arms are scored on the SAME cases through the SAME pipeline and differ in one column, so the paired case-level bootstrap used elsewhere applies directly. The paper reported this difference without an interval while six secondary comparisons carried one.
